meta.name: Basanta Ese Geche
meta.description: The story of three different people trapped in the game of love. Tiyasha, a teenager engineering student lives her life on her own terms, madly in love Nishan who is much older than him. Nishan is a happily married man with Chandrima.

videos.title: লাল (RED) | Ep 1 | Basanta Ese Geche
videos.overview: Tiyasha finally decides to confess her love to her Maths teacher & writes an anonymous letter. Nishan is upset with this as he is happily married, so he brings the letter home & hands over to Chandrima, his wife. Chandrima plans to play along.
